subject: Social Media
title: Growth Hacking Origins
description: A quick, practical guide to Growth Hacking Origins.

hook.text: Sean Ellis coined 'growth hacking' in 2010. He meant marketing run by engineers, not Mad Men.

buildup.text: Growth hackers treat user acquisition like a code problem. Run experiments, measure results, iterate.

discovery.text: Airbnb hacked Craigslist—cross-posting listings without permission. Millions of users poured in.

twist.text: Growth hacking blurred ethics. Many tactics exploited dark patterns: tricking users into inviting friends.

climax.text: The era faded as platforms closed loopholes. But the mindset survived. Every startup still thinks in hacks.

punchline.text: Growth hacking isn't marketing. It's engineering luck.
